summary: Mail keeps working after an identity move, with one clear fix when a send is refused.

fixes.title: Mail fixes name the right identity
fixes.text: After an identity move, PIM Manager names the identity the engine signs in as. A refused mail send shows one fix command with the real identity, tenant and mailbox.

fixes.title: Admin rights stay with the engine
fixes.text: The identity move never copies User Access Administrator or Owner to any role but the engine.
